messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — planning activation of vortex-6b-quant in the model catalog during tonight's change window at 22:00 PDT. Initial rollout: 10% traffic for 30m.
Sanjay Patel: ACK. Fallback ordering?
Maria Chen: Fallback order will be: vortex-6b-fp16 -> comet-13b-v2 -> legacy-default. We'll pin the quant variant at low weight during canary.
Kevin Wu: Add rollback triggers: p95 latency > 400ms sustained for 5m OR error-rate delta > 0.5% absolute. Also watch token-cost anomaly.
Anya Roy: I'll run the QA eval set against the canary before and after. If eval score drops > 2 pts we abort.
Maria Chen: @deploybot please schedule activation at 22:00 PDT and post status updates in this thread. Also coordinate cache warmup 15m prior.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled activation for 2026-03-22T22:00:00-07:00 (canary window 30m). Pre-warm: 15m before on dedicated pool. Will report canary metrics.
Sanjay Patel: For warmup, we'll run lightweight prefix-heavy requests. Kevin, can you paste the warmup curl?
Kevin Wu: Sure — run: `curl -X POST https://infra.internal/warmup -d '{"model":"vortex-6b-quant","tokens":200,"rate":50}'`
Anya Roy: Exclusions: please exclude production-critical customer routes and EU-high-latency legacy flows from the canary sample. We'll sample global low-volume traffic only.
deploybot: canary started: 10% global-sampled traffic (exclusions applied). Posted initial metrics to telemetry.
deploybot: canary update (T+15m): p95 latency 220ms, errors 0.02%, token-cost +3% vs fp16. No safety triggers hit.
Maria Chen: Thanks — plan is to expand to 30% after 1h if stable. Manual rollback command: `rb vortex-6b-quant`. If anyone sees anomalies ping me + @Sanjay immediately. :thumbsup:
